newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Hot winds wreak havoc in western Austria.
newsitem.headline: Hot winds wreak havoc in western Austria.

text.p: Hot winds gusting up to 150 kilometres (90 miles) per hour lashed western Austria's Alps during the night, wreaking widespread damage and causing several injuries, Austrian radio said on Tuesday.
The western-most province of Vorarlberg, a stone's throw from Switzerland where the same winds blew over a heavy railway car in the Swiss Alps, was the hardest hit.

The Arlberg railway line was temporarily blocked by fallen trees, as was the railway link to Switzerland while numerous roads had to be closed. Electricity and telephone lines were also down in the region.
The winds, known as foehn, are hot southerly winds on the northern slopes of the Alps.
